english.title: Contravene provision of Cosmetics Regulation - breach article 11 / 13 / 16 / 21 / 24
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) contravened article

(A)_[11 of the Cosmetics Regulation No. 1223/2009, relating to requirements for the product information file,]_
(B)_[13 of the Cosmetics Regulation No. 1223/2009, relating to notification requirements,]_
(C)_[16 of the Cosmetics Regulation No. 1223/2009, relating to notification requirements in relation to nano materials,]_
(D)_[21 of the Cosmetics Regulation No. 1223/2009, relating to access to information for the public,]_
(E)_[24 of the Cosmetics Regulation No. 1223/2009, relating to information requirements on substances,]_

in that **(..SPECIFY CONTRAVENTION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 12(1) and 13(2) of the Cosmetic Products Enforcement Regulations 2013.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:

(ii) See regulation 23 for the defence of due diligence.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex, see regulation 22.

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
